Unexpected outbound activity

After opening a suspicious attachment, an endpoint initiated repeated outbound connections.

The destination was 203.0.113.42, accompanied by DNS queries for update.example.org.

Review the destination reputation and exposed services. Correlate the results with endpoint evidence before deciding on containment.

Sources → Global verdict

Many sources.
One clearer picture.

Compare reputation with context. VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB provide signals, Shodan adds service context, and MISP connects internal intelligence.

IP enrichment supports VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Shodan and MISP. Domain enrichment supports VirusTotal and MISP. MISP uses your configured instance, not a public pivot.

Enriched results require configured services; detection and external pivots do not.

Carry the evidence forward.

Add an analyst note. Copy an investigation export. Download JSON or add an indicator to your configured MISP instance.

  • Notes
  • JSON export
  • MISP

Keep the rationale with the investigation. Notes are stored locally in the extension. MISP submission is an explicit action to a configured event.

Analyst Assist.
A second perspective.

AI-generated investigation briefs, suggested next steps and correlation across your investigation history. Your judgment stays in charge.

Opt in and connect your OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including local models. Mustela remains usable without AI.

Example AI brief
  1. Validate the related process.
  2. Correlate network and DNS activity.
  3. Escalate if the evidence confirms compromise.
Illustrative output only. This fixture never calls a model.

Your browser.
Your investigation.

No Mustela backend or account. Extension settings and analyst notes are stored locally.

Provider lookups, configured MISP and optional Analyst Assist contact their configured destinations. External pivots open third-party sites.

With Analyst Assist enabled and configured, uncached investigations automatically send IOC, provider summaries and available page URL/title to your chosen endpoint. Correlation sends selected history through a separate action. A local-first architecture does not mean zero disclosure.
